in_sanskrit.name: Parineeti
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Near to the heart
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Parineeti एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Parineeti is a Sanskrit name derived from the word pari, meaning 'near', and neti, meaning 'heart'. The name symbolizes being close to one's heart, love, and affection.

in_hindi.name: परिनेती
in_hindi.meaning: परा (para) - near, close; नेता (neta) - leader, guide
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who is near or close to a leader or guide
